dataset.name: Canadian pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (ICGC PACA-CA)
dataset.description: Independent Canadian pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas from the Canadian Pancreatic Cancer Sequencing Initiative. Many profiles were generated after laser-capture microdissection and therefore represent an epithelial-enriched context distinct from bulk TCGA-PAAD.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer uses endpoint-complete PACA-CA donors with an open Ensembl/Cufflinks RNA-seq analysis linked to a project-designated primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. One analysis is selected deterministically per donor; pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors belong to separate ICGC PAEN projects.

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The ICGC adapter applies source.duplicate_gene_policy before this matrix is materialized: all occurrences of repeated Ensembl identifiers are removed rather than aggregated. It then removes symbols mapped from multiple remaining Ensembl genes, so the matrix supplied to the generic builder is unique.
expression.scale_note: ICGC provides non-negative Cufflinks-normalized expression values on the FPKM scale. Repeated source Ensembl identifiers are discarded rather than aggregated, after which TRACE Explorer maps identifiers with the pinned GRCh37 reference and applies log2(value + 1) once.
